create_CameraSubscriber: create a CameraSubscriber that subscribes to the cams/rgbd topic and retrieves recent RGBD frames
create_PointCloudSubscriber: create a PointCloudSubscriber that converts multi-camera RGBD data into Open3D point clouds using intrinsics and extrinsics
run_get_pcd_i: run get_pcd_i on a PointCloudSubscriber to generate a single camera point cloud from an RGBD array and optional mask
run_get_pcd: run get_pcd on a PointCloudSubscriber to merge point clouds from all cameras into one combined point cloud
run_camera_logger_main: run the main block to log Realsense camera intrinsics and publish RGBD frames to the cams/rgbd topic
